notes.title: Dev Note: Inspirations Behind Death at Fleming Manor
notes.content:
[h2]Dev Note: Inspirations Behind [i]Death at Fleming Manor[/i][/h2][p]This time, we’d like to share some of the games and media that have inspired us [/p][p]while creating [i]Death at Fleming Manor[/i].[/p][p]
We believe that knowing our tastes and influences might give you a better idea of [/p][p]what kind of game to expect.[/p][p][/p][h3]1. Games that inspired [i]Death at Fleming Manor[/i][/h3][list][*][p][b]The Case of the Golden Idol[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Return of the Obra Dinn[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Papers, Please[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]The Roottrees are Dead[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]2. Mystery & adventure games we love[/h3][list][*][p][b]Ace Attorney series[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Danganronpa series[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Gabriel Knight: Sins of the Fathers[/b] – especially the art style[/p][/*][*][p][b]Laura Bow: The Colonel’s Bequest (Sierra)[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Of course, we also enjoy many other genres. [/p][p]We usually make sure to play all the major GOTY contenders as well.[/p][p][/p][h3]3. Comics we enjoy[/h3][list][*][p][b]European comics[/b]: [i]Snowpiercer[/i], [i]The Adventures of Tintin[/i], works by Floc’h[/p][/*][*][p][b]Japanese comics[/b]: thrillers by Naoki Urasawa, horror by Kazuo Umezz[/p][/*][*][p][b]American comics[/b]: crime detective comics[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]4. Films & shows we referenced during development[/h3][list][*][p][i]Agatha Christie’s Poirot[/i] (starring David Suchet)[/p][/*][*][p][i]Endeavour[/i] (British drama)[/p][/*][*][p][i]Crooked House[/i] (film)[/p][/*][/list][p]We often look to these works for inspiration on characters, settings, and interiors.[/p][p][/p][h3]5. Other mystery games[/h3][p]Board games have also been a big source of inspiration:[/p][list][*][p][i]Sherlock Holmes Consulting Detective[/i][/p][/*][*][p]CLUE[/p][/*][*][p]Watson & Holmes [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The story of the game is already complete.
Right now, we’re working like we’re piecing together a puzzle, carefully building the full experience.
Before releasing the demo, we want to polish things further so that we can show you the best version possible.[/p][p]We’ll continue sharing our development progress like this from time to time.
Thank you very much for your interest and support![/p]

notes.title: we have already reached 12,000 wishlists!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638549/7a752b912ab2e0435d01b0568cb9df6976a7eb24.png"][/img][/p][h2]Wishlist Milestone Update[/h2][p][/p][p]We have something to celebrate for [i]Death at Fleming Manor[/i]![/p][p][/p][p]Because of the BIC 2025 exhibition, we weren’t able to properly announce our wishlist milestones.[/p][p]
We had planned to share our gratitude at 10,000 wishlists, but time passed quickly...[/p][p][/p][p]Today, we are happy to announce that we have already reached [b]12,000 wishlists[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p]We’re very thankful for all of your support.[/p][p]
The public demo will be available soon, so please look forward to it.[/p][p][/p][p]Once again, thank you so much for adding [i]Death at Fleming Manor[/i] to your wishlist.[/p]

notes.title: "Death at Fleming Manor" Successfully Exhibited at BIC 2025
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638549/87f1fc3f7b5dfdda018aee7e39479fd23cf4e77a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]"Death at Fleming Manor" was showcased at the Busan Indie Game Festival (BIC 2025), [/p][p]held from August 15 to 17.[/p][p]The game received an overwhelmingly positive response during the exhibition.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638549/84213cb4213febe71e44ad42a864c91e790c1190.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We started the event with just two demo PCs, but due to the continuous interest from players, we ended up running demos on four computers, including two of our development laptops, non-stop.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638549/869bf3a8cd7801ac47fe91a06a8d6301de1315a4.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Over 170 people played the game, and we collected 120 survey responses.[/p][p][/p][p]Korean outlets 'Game Insight' and 'ThisIsGame', as well as Japan’s 4Gamer, published great articles about the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We received strong praise for the quality of the deduction gameplay, and also valuable feedback about [/p][p]areas where the difficulty might feel high—suggesting we improve accessibility and hints.[/p][p][/p][p]We gained a significant number of wishlists during BIC 2025 and will soon be announcing the new milestone we’ve reached.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your support. We’ll keep working hard to finish the game well![/p]

notes.title: Death at Fleming Manor just hit 2,000 wishlists!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638549/a28bc3849bb796423d997f14ee8a7dc60d196df5.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Death at Fleming Manor[/b] just hit [b]2,000 wishlists[/b]![/p][p]Thank you all so much for your incredible support![/p][p]We truly appreciate it![/p]

notes.title: Death at Fleming Manor to Join BIC2025 (Busan Indie Connect) in South Korea
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638549/ba1d1b92f7bdcd0f54ad9e6888c91137908f81c5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][i]Death at Fleming Manor [/i]is officially participating in[/h3][h3][b]BIC2025 (Busan Indie Connect)[/b] in South Korea![/h3][p][b]ONLINE[/b]: August 8 – August 29 → [url="http://bicfest.org"]http://bicfest.org[/url]
[b]OFFLINE[/b]: August 15 – August 17 at BEXCO[/p][p]Set in a grand British manor in 1959,
this is a full-scale [b]forensic mystery adventure[/b] game.[/p][p]You’ll be able to [b]try the demo early at BIC[/b] —
and we’re also preparing a playable demo for Steam soon![/p][p]Whether online or in person, we hope you'll come and check it out![/p]

notes.title: More Languages Coming to Death at Fleming Manor!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello to everyone waiting for [i]Death at Fleming Manor[/i]![/b][/p][p]Thanks to your incredible support and interest, we’ve decided to expand the language support for [i]Death at Fleming Manor[/i].[/p][p]In addition to the previously planned languages, we will now also support [b]German, French, Italian, Spanish, and Portuguese[/b].[/p][p]This process may take some time, but we want as many players as possible to experience the depth of the story and the thrill of deduction — in their own language.[/p][p]Thank you once again for your patience and enthusiasm.
We’ll keep working hard to deliver the best experience possible![/p][p] The SUPERTHUMb Team[/p]

notes.title: Welcome to the Community of Death at Fleming Manor!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45638549/c1cdd45fc4f9529ad1bf05363de8e717623000c2.png"][/img][/p][p]Welcome, investigators.[/p][p]We're SUPERTHUMb — an indie dev duo from South Korea, and this is our upcoming mystery adventure, 'Death at Fleming Manor'.[/p][p]This is a forensic deduction game set in 1959 Britain. You'll examine crime scenes, analyze clues, and write real medical documents — like death certificates.[/p][p][/p][p]We just opened the Steam page, and we're thrilled (and nervous!) to share our work with you.[/p][p]This community is where we’ll:[/p][p]- Share updates and development progress[/p][p]- Answer questions and chat with you[/p][p]- Hear your thoughts and feedback![/p][p][/p][p]💬 Feel free to say hello, ask us anything, or even tell us your favorite mystery game.[/p][p]Thanks for joining us on this investigation.[/p][p]We’ll do our best to make it worth your while![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://community.fastly.steamstatic.com/economy/emoticon/steamthumbsup"][/img]SUPERTHUMb[/p]
